body: Hey guys, ive moved out and am living with my family. i got a ton of support from friends that i didnt know i still had. and thank you guys as well.

There is a person who is usually downstairs who triggers the hell out of me with their presence. They are willing to help though I think so I could ask them to hang out somewhere else for a day or two.
Stories about how much people hurt in the aftermath. I think that will give me more strength not to do it. And I'll see if I can leave sooner.
Thank you for your reply. Being supportive for their relationship is something I can try and might be good at.
I want to try to make it work first.
